meta.name: respond-to-military-defeat
meta.description: Use when recovering from a major military defeat or rebuilding forces after a loss. Based on Duke Mu's response to the Xiao defeat, covers personal accountability, commander restoration, public acknowledgment, and rebuilding strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从军事失败中恢复并重建力量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从重大失败中恢复并重建团队或组织。
copy.tagline_en: Recover from a major military defeat and rebuild forces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to recover from a major defeat and rebuild your team or organization.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按步骤引导你应对军事失败：承认失败、承担个人责任、荣誉迎接归来指挥官、恢复其职位、公开承认错误、重建军队并再次尝试、纪念阵亡者。
howto.when: 当你从重大军事失败中恢复，或失败后需要重建军队时，Claude会接管并执行这套流程。

say.text: 我刚经历了一场大败，请指导我如何承担责任和重建军队。
我的将军们被俘后回来了，我该如何对待他们？
say.note: 执行荣誉迎接和恢复职位步骤。

say.text: 我想公开承认我的失误，该怎么做？
say.note: 执行公开承认和记录教训步骤。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will guide you through steps to respond to a military defeat: acknowledge the loss, take personal responsibility, honor returning commanders, restore their positions, issue a public acknowledgment, rebuild forces, and commemorate the fallen.
howto.when_en: Triggered when recovering from a major military defeat or rebuilding forces after a loss.

say_en.text: I just suffered a major defeat. Guide me on taking responsibility and rebuilding.
My commanders have returned from captivity. How should I treat them?
I want to publicly admit my fault. What should I do?
say_en.note: Executes public acknowledgment and recording steps.
